compatibility_regressions: Raw fixture parameter strings may become quoted in --setup-show output.
Long raw fixture parameter representations may be truncated by saferepr's default size limit.
summary: The interview resolved the issue-time material decision directly and the sealed contract accurately reflects the audited rendering path, existing saferepr utility, shared setup/teardown behavior, and explicit-ID distinction. It preserves every recorded owner choice and clearly scopes the accepted user-visible changes. Hindsight shows the gold patch also repr-rendered explicit IDs and used a specific 42-character limit, but those are implementation outcomes rather than issue-time requirements; they do not invalidate the approved contract.
